They were dropped by almost any monster in Misthalin and Asgarnia or, more specifically, the area between Rimmington and the Lumber Yard.
They were also obtained in a special "Around the World" drop party held by a Jagex Moderator.
It was possible to obtain multiple cakes during the event.

A Crafting level of 45 is required to create the shield, using an anti-dragon shield and a clingy mole, which is a rare drop from the giant mole.
The shield is created with its maximum of 500 charges.

Arrav is a cosmetic override set available from Solomon's General Store for 360 RuneCoins for members.

Attack flask.x: The is a potion flask containing six doses of potion. It is created by using potions on a potion flask. Only the six-dose flask is tradeable on the Grand Exchange, but lower-dose versions can still be traded directly with other players.

sc: The Third Age-dyed augmented Khopesh of Tumeken is a level 92 Melee weapon, created by using an augmentor on a Khopesh of Tumeken (Third Age), or by using Third Age dye on an augmented Khopesh of Tumeken.

The shadow-dyed augmented malevolent greaves is a level 90 Melee legs slot power armour, created by using an augmentor and divine charges on a malevolent greaves (shadow), or by using shadow dye on an augmented malevolent greaves.
The augmented Pernix chaps are a tier 80 ranged legs slot item created by using an augmentor on Pernix chaps.

sc: The augmented refined anima core legs of Seren is created by using an augmentor and divine charges on a refined anima core legs of Seren.
Aviansie talons are a common drop from smoke nihil.
Bass is a type of fish obtained by cooking a raw bass on a fire or cooking range with level 43 Cooking.
A cooked bass is sometimes dropped by blue dragons, green dragons, elves, terror dogs, ankous, grotworms and are a possible reward from a Gourmet impling jar.
A beer-soaked hand is obtained during The Hand in the Sand quest by giving a severed hand to the captain of the guard in the Dragon Inn in Yanille.
A biohazard cannister is a common drop from zombies in Dimension of the Damned.
They can also be bought from Zrik's Cork Shop for 250 bottle corks.

Black heraldic armour set 5 (sk).x: Black heraldic armour set 5 (sk) is an item obtained by exchanging a set of items with a Grand Exchange clerk via their right-click "Exchange" option, followed by the "Sets" tab and clicking on the appropriate item set within the Item Sets interface.

sc: The third age-dyed Blightbound crossbow is made by dyeing a blightbound crossbow with a third age dye.
It is made by using the desert lizard bone with a pot of vinegar.
Box of stroopwafels is a box containing seven stroopwafels which could be obtained daily from Wilhelm, just north of the windmill in Taverley, during the 10 Year Dutch Community Anniversary event.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 80 primal bars and a primal platebody + 4, requiring 8,800 progress to complete, granting a total of 112,000 Smithing experience.
It can be made into primal burial platebody for additional experience.
Two Carnillean lamps are awarded for completing the Carnillean Rising quest.
Charcoal can be found by searching the tall shelves of the house in Past A during the Meeting History quest.
Chitin scraps are used to repair drygore weaponry, and may be obtained by using a damaged chitin on an anvil, awarding 10 Smithing experience per damaged chitin.
More than 46 scraps can be obtained if the Smithing level is boosted higher.
Clue scroll (easy) is an emote clue obtained from easy sealed clue scrolls.
Clue scroll (easy) is a simple clue obtained from easy sealed clue scrolls.

Clue scroll (hard) - 04 degrees 03 minut.x: Clue scroll (hard) is a coordinate clue obtained from hard sealed clue scrolls. It contains a clue to solve Treasure Trails.

sc: Compacted hides is an item obtained from training Hunter and killing dinosaurs on Anachronia.
It can also be obtained on occasion while skilling in the Dream of Iaia.
Cooked eeligator is a food item that can be bought from goebie suppliers in their shops in Kanatah and Otot or received as a drop from Beastmaster Durzag or Yakamaru.
The name appears to be a portmanteau of 'eel' and 'alligator', although it is unknown what an eeligator actually is as none can be found or are described in-game.

Corbi.x: Corbi is a boss pet that can be obtained by using the Pristine Corbicula rex egg which is obtained as a drop from killing Rathis, the Corbicula Rex Matriarch.

sc: A corrupt Morrigan's leather body is a part of the corrupt Morrigan's equipment PvP armour set, obtained from killing revenants in the Forinthry Dungeon, or as a very rare drop from the Chaos Elemental.

Culinaromancer's gloves 8, also called rune gloves, are special metal gloves that can be bought from the Culinaromancer's Chest after completion of 7 subquests in Recipe for Disaster (not including the starting subquest).
This piece of armour cannot be made using the Smithing skill.

Death Reaper Hood.x: The Death Reaper Hood is a head slot cosmetic override that is part of the Death Reaper Vestments outfit. It can be unlocked by purchasing the Death Reaper Vestments Set. It is an upgraded version of the Death Bringer Hood, unlocked by completing 25 Slayer assignments while having any Death Seeker or Death Bringer cosmetic active.

Dervish hood (violet).x: The violet dervish hood is part of the dervish outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: While the hood is bought with the skillcape, it is not needed to perform the emote associated with it; the skillcape is the only essential item.
Dominion Tower maul was a cosmetic prize obtained from Treasure Hunter in the very rare slot, or from a sparkling clover necklace.
It was discontinued in March 2015, with 1,500 being available in the rare token store.
It could be obtained by digging at mounds with a spade above the Easter Bunny's burrow with a spade after they were buried by a Rabbit, or by picking one up from a pile in the burrow.
Elegant Sun Hat is a head slot cosmetic override unlocked by redeeming a Elegant Sun Hat token.

Elf-style dress top (silver).x: The silver elf-style dress top is part of the elven outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: The evidence file is a collection of five letters obtained during A Clockwork Syringe.
The exquisite crossbow is a multi-tier weapon that was a reward from the Squeal of Fortune.

It can be purchased for 99,000 coins (or 92,000 coins with the ring of charos (a) or its imbued version) alongside the Farming hood from Martin the Master Gardener at the Draynor Village marketplace by players who have achieved level 99 in Farming.
It was made by combining a focus sight, hexcrest and slayer helmet (which had to be uncharged beforehand) by using one on any of the others.
The helm could hold a maximum of 20 ferocious ring charges and 40 ring of slaying charges, made by using the rings on the helmet and requiring 60 Crafting.
The Gemi Halo appearance token is a unlock token awarded to Fresh Start Accounts that unlock the Gemi pet during the Fresh Start Worlds gamemode.
The token can be traded, once, directly to another player (it is not available on the Grand Exchange).
The ghostly jester gloves are part of the ghostly jester outfit which is made with 600 ghostweave.

Golem of Justice Gauntlets.x: Golem of Justice Gauntlets is a hands slot cosmetic override that is part of the Golem of Justice set.

sc: After completing the medium Morytania achievements, 13 gorilla bonemeal and 13 bucket of slime can be obtained daily by giving gorilla bones to Robin in Port Phasmatys.

Gossamer Robes Bottom.x: The Gossamer Robes Bottom is a legs slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Gossamer outfit.

sc: The initiate tasset is the plateskirt piece of Initiate armour that can be obtained from the Initiate Temple Knight Armoury or Proselyte Temple Knight Armoury run by Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador after completing the Recruitment Drive quest.
It can also be obtained by unpacking an initiate harness (f).
It, along with the regular runecrafting skillcape, could be unlocked by accounts in the Fresh Start Worlds game mode that reached level 99 Runecrafting.

The cape can also still be unlocked by any account in the main game by consuming an Inverted Runecrafting skillcape token, though the inverted cape can only be equipped if the player also has level 99 Runecrafting.

Invictum Helm.x: The Invictum Helm is a head slot cosmetic override that is part of the Invictum Outfit. Along with the rest of the outfit, it can be unlocked by spending 100% respect in the Artisans' Workshop.

sc: The Jaws board is a cosmetic that can be purchased for free from the Surfboard tab of Flo's shop during The Beach (2020).

sc: A sandy maul override token is an item that could originally be obtained through The Beach (2018).
It can be obtained as a drop in the God Wars Dungeon, from the Saradominist general Commander Zilyana and her bodyguards, Bree, Growler and Starlight.

The Saradomin sword can be considered a crushing counterpart of the Zamorakian spear and the four godswords, which are stabbing and slashing weapons respectively, as all three weapons are tier 75 two-handed melee weapons which can be obtained from their respective generals in the God Wars Dungeon.
Despite being a free-to-play item, it can only be obtained by members.
Free players can only obtain it by trading.
Seeping elm shortbow is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Fletching skill.
The Shard of havoc weapon token is a potential reward item from a loot chest dropped by the Giant Mimic.
Unfeathered silver bolts are silver bolts made from a single silver bar before a feather is added.
A small XP lamp (Agility) is a possible reward from helping Meg in your player-owned port.
It is also one of the lamps that can be obtained by buying a random small XP lamp from the Waiko Reward Shop run by Boni on Waiko for 1,400 chimes.
Burning tansymum is a great way to obtain ashes in bulk, especially when players put tansymum and smouldering tansymum on the action bar, and use the hotkeys.
Soulbell can be found in the Sinkholes Distraction and Diversion.
It is made by combining chopped garlic with Gnome spice.
It is made by using a Summoning pouch on a Summoning obelisk with 116 spirit shards, a crimson charm, and a snake hide in the backpack, requiring 63 Summoning and giving 276.
It can be made into ten Spirit Cobra scrolls (Ophidian Incubation) by using it on a summoning obelisk, giving 3.
The spiritbloom robe bottom is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering inside Daemonheim.
It may be obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Crafting skill.
The Spooky Raven is a companion pet that could be purchased for 10,000 oddments from the Marketplace.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 35 of Count Yakula's Yak Track.
The stasis bow is a two-handed ranged weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 42 of the Kerapac Track.
Steak and kidney pie was a food item sold by Bang Ersenmash at his Exotic Foods shop in Varrock Square in celebration of the Diamond Jubilee.
A Stormguard Citadel invitation is given to the player automatically once they reach level 70 Archaeology.
A Strength XP lamp is given as a reward for completing A Shadow over Ashdale.
Summertwirls are a type of rare mushroom found while foraging mushroom clusters on Uncharted Isles within the Arc region of the Wushanko Isles.
The Path of the Elemental is a book dropped by the slayer monsters on Aminishi as part of the Spiritual Enlightenment miniquest.
It is dropped by a variety of trolls.
After the wishlist is completed, players can no longer obtain this as a drop.
A tropical coconut is an item obtained by picking them from the palm trees in Sunlight Sands for Farming experience.
Any remaining tropical coconuts are removed from players when the event they were obtained during ends.
Tyrannoleather coif is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Crafting skill.
The price was reduced if parts of the set were obtained from Treasure Hunter prior to the set being moved to the Marketplace.
The Yin yang amulet is an amulet which can be purchased from the Makeover Mage for 100 coins.

When it was released, the amulet was tradeable, however players quickly began taking advantage of other players who did not read the Postbag, and thus did not know that the amulet was easily obtainable.
